data.body: [P2] The no-plugin branch unconditionally clears MDC instead of restoring the map present when the task began. With a direct executor, a deserialization or startup failure before `DurableLogger` establishes its scope clears the caller's ambient MDC; on a reused worker it also discards application-owned entries. Snapshot and restore the previous map in `finally`, using the same cleanup-failure policy as the plugin path, and cover a direct executor with pre-populated MDC plus an input-deserialization failure.
